stem: A community pharmacy receives manufacturer-packaged tablets that are identified as hazardous drugs. The pharmacy will store and dispense the intact tablets but will not compound them. A manager says hazardous-drug standards are irrelevant because no compounding will occur. Which approach is most accurate?

choices.text: Treat the shipment as ordinary inventory because hazardous-drug standards begin only when a dosage form is compounded.
Apply current hazardous-drug handling standards to the applicable receipt, storage, dispensing, and disposal activities even though the pharmacy is not compounding the tablets.
Apply sterile-compounding cleanroom rules to every intact hazardous tablet before it may be dispensed.
Return every hazardous drug to the wholesaler because community pharmacies may not possess hazardous drugs.
Follow hazardous-drug controls only if the prescription is for an employee of the pharmacy.

explanation.core_reasoning: Massachusetts 247 CMR 9.01 makes current applicable USP standards part of pharmacy practice unless otherwise regulated by the Board. USP <800> addresses hazardous-drug handling beyond compounding, including receipt, storage, dispensing, and disposal. The absence of compounding does not remove all hazardous-drug obligations.

choice_analysis.A: Hazardous-drug handling is broader than compounding.
choice_analysis.B: Correct: the handling framework follows the hazardous drug through applicable operational stages.
choice_analysis.C: Intact hazardous tablets do not automatically trigger sterile cleanroom processing.
choice_analysis.D: Community pharmacies are not categorically barred from possessing hazardous drugs.
choice_analysis.E: The legal framework does not depend on whether the patient works for the pharmacy.

explanation.mpje_trap: Do not reduce USP <800> to a compounding-only rule.

reasoning_steps: Identify that the product is hazardous even though it remains intact
Distinguish hazardous-drug handling from sterile-compounding requirements
Apply the hazardous-drug framework to the operational stages actually occurring
